name: King
lines: On Land, moves or captures one king step, or one level straight up or down to the same file and rank.
On Sky or Underworld, moves or captures only straight back to Land.

name: Mage
lines: On Land, moves or captures like a queen.
On Land, may instead move or capture one level straight up or down.
On Sky or Underworld, moves or captures one step orthogonally.
On Sky or Underworld, may instead move or capture one or two levels straight up or down.
Two-level moves cannot pass through an occupied Land square.

name: Paladin
lines: On Land, moves or captures like a king or a knight.
On Sky or Underworld, moves or captures like a king.
Between levels, moves or captures with an unblockable 3D knight leap.
The leap is one level plus two squares orthogonally, or two levels plus one square orthogonally.

name: Cleric
lines: On any level, moves or captures one king step.
On any level, may instead move or capture one level straight up or down.

name: Dragon
lines: On Sky only, moves or captures like a bishop or a king.
Instead of moving, it may capture one enemy piece on Land remotely.
The target must be directly below the Dragon, or orthogonally next to that square.
The Dragon stays put when it captures remotely.

name: Griffon
lines: On Sky, leaps 2 and 3 squares like a zebra, and the leap cannot be blocked.
On Sky, may instead make a triagonal step down to Land.
A triagonal step goes to a square diagonally next to the square directly above or below.
On Land, moves or captures one step diagonally, or makes a triagonal step up to Sky.

name: Oliphant
lines: On Land only, moves or captures like a rook.
It never moves or captures on Sky or Underworld.

name: Hero
lines: On Land, moves or captures 1 or 2 steps diagonally.
On Land, may instead make a triagonal step to Sky or to Underworld.
On Sky or Underworld, the only move is a triagonal step back to Land.

name: Thief
lines: On Land only, moves or captures like a bishop.
It never moves or captures on Sky or Underworld.

name: Elemental
lines: On Underworld, moves or captures 1 or 2 squares orthogonally, without leaping.
On Underworld, moves without capturing 1 square diagonally.
On Underworld, captures only 1 square orthogonally, then up to Land.
The Underworld square passed through must be empty.
On Land, moves or captures down to Underworld, then 1 square orthogonally, if the square below is empty.

name: Basilisk
lines: On Underworld only, moves or captures 1 square forward or diagonally forward.
On Underworld, moves without capturing 1 square straight back.
Freezes any enemy piece directly above it on Land.
A frozen piece cannot move or capture until the Basilisk moves or is captured.

name: Unicorn
lines: On Land only, moves or captures like a knight.
It never moves or captures on Sky or Underworld.

name: Dwarf
lines: Forward means toward the enemy's home rank.
On Underworld or Land, moves without capturing 1 square forward or 1 square sideways.
On Underworld or Land, captures 1 square diagonally forward.
On Underworld, may also capture straight up onto Land.
On Land, may also move without capturing straight down to Underworld.

name: Sylph
lines: On Sky, moves without capturing 1 square diagonally forward.
On Sky, captures 1 square straight forward, or 1 square straight down to Land.
On Land, moves without capturing straight up to Sky.
On Land, may instead move without capturing to any empty one of the owner's six Sylph starting squares.
Sylphs never promote.

name: Warrior
lines: On Land only, moves without capturing 1 square straight forward, with no double step.
Captures 1 square diagonally forward.
Promotes to Hero on reaching the far rank.
